evaluations.title: Default branch is missing required review protection
evaluations.message: The default branch allows direct pushes without mandatory peer review.

remediation.summary: Require pull request reviews and prevent force pushes on the default branch.

evaluations.title: Change control protections are incomplete
evaluations.message: Repository changes can reach production branches without approved pull request checks.

remediation.summary: Enforce required pull request approvals and status checks before merge.
